authorization: Mario requested a test with SQLite and a vector plugin
purpose: Compare the agent-maintenance persistence contracts already exercised with LanceDB
storage: Private local database owned by this experiment; synthetic records only

cases.expected: Original, harness/session/event and null vector survive a reopen, including reads without loading the vector extension
All 60 distinct acknowledged observations survive with exact IDs and provenance
One acknowledged capture and three idempotent recognitions leave one original
Two simultaneous attempts of the same operation leave one original without an external file lock
Two updates from revision 0 produce one accepted change and one conflict, with final revision 1
New autocommit reads see another process's commit; a deliberately open read transaction retains its snapshot until it ends
SIGKILL after batch-start notification preserves confirmed prefix and leaves the batch absent or complete, never partial
The same five LanceDB fixture records support scoped vector and textual queries; custom RRF combines the two with a documented deterministic tie break
SIGKILL after explicitly inserting 37 uncommitted batch rows preserves six prior commits and removes all uncommitted rows
Different content under one operation ID, or a different operation under one record ID, cannot overwrite the original
Invalid vector dimensions roll back the embedding operation while the previously confirmed raw observation remains readable
Failure between core vector update and vector-index insertion rolls back both changes; a successful write publishes both together

comparison_basis: Same record constructor, worker count, IDs, texts, vectors, repetitions and public behavioral expectations as the LanceDB experiment; execution on a different day is not a controlled timing benchmark
limits: No models or generated embeddings; retrieval quality and classification improvement are unmeasured
Small finite sample on macOS local disk only
SQLite serializes writes; busy timeout is not an unlimited availability guarantee
Synthetic SIGKILL probes do not establish power-loss durability
Hybrid RRF is supplied by the experiment; sqlite-vec does not implement the entire hybrid workflow
No active installation or approved production adapter
